description: Registers that your user is interested in a feature Overfit has PLANNED but not built yet (e.g. sign-in from the chat, credit top-up, API keys, which tenders a company has won, law text on a date, tender alerts, data packages). The planned features with one value sentence each are listed in overfit_catalog under `planned`. Call this when the user wants one of them: Overfit sees every request and builds the most requested first. Optional notiz: what the user would use it for (max 280 characters, no personal data).

feature.description: Id of the planned feature from overfit_catalog `planned`, e.g. 'konto_im_chat'.

name.description: Optional: your agent or project name (max 60 characters).

notiz.description: Optional: what the user wants to do with it (max 280 characters).

name: interesse_melden
title: Interesse an geplanter Funktion melden
